svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="tpR8dHwlliia2NsQE1Ky"> <mxGraphModel dx="4040" dy="2653" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
title Process Startup, Monitoring and Recovery

autonumber
hide footbox

participant \"Application\n(main)\" as App
participant \"Process Launcher\" as Launcher
participant \"Health Monitor\" as Monitor

participant \"Traffic Signal\nController\" as FSM
participant \"Traffic Timing\nDecision\" as Decision
participant \"Traffic Perception\" as Vision
participant \"Analytics\" as Analytics

== System Startup ==

activate App

App -> App : loadConfiguration()
activate App
App -->> App: ConfigStatus
deactivate App
 
App -> App : initializeIPC()
activate App
App -->> App: ipcStatus
deactivate App

App -> Launcher : launchProcesses()

activate Launcher

group Launch Traffic Signal Controller

Launcher -> Launcher : fork()+exec(FSM)
activate Launcher
Launcher -->> Launcher : fsmPid
deactivate Launcher 

Launcher -> FSM : start()

activate FSM
FSM -->> Launcher : Ready(PID)

end

group Launch Traffic Timing Decision

Launcher -> Launcher : fork()+exec(Decision)

activate Launcher
Launcher -->> Launcher : decisionPid
deactivate Launcher 

Launcher -> Decision : start()

activate Decision
Decision -->> Launcher : Ready(PID)

end

group Launch Traffic Perception

Launcher -> Launcher : fork()+exec(Vision)
activate Launcher
Launcher -->> Launcher : visionPid 
deactivate Launcher 
Launcher -> Vision : start()

activate Vision
Vision -->> Launcher : Ready(PID)

end

group Launch Analytics

Launcher -> Launcher : fork()+exec(Analytics)
activate Launcher
Launcher -->> Launcher : analyticsPid 
deactivate Launcher 

Launcher -> Analytics : start()

activate Analytics
Analytics -->> Launcher : Ready(PID)

end

Launcher -> Launcher : storeProcessInfo()
activate Launcher
Launcher -->> Launcher : processTableUpdated 
deactivate Launcher 

Launcher -->> App : ProcessInfo

deactivate Launcher

App ->> Monitor : registerProcesses(ProcessInfo)

activate Monitor
Monitor -> Monitor : initializeWatchList()
activate Monitor
Monitor -->> Monitor : watchlistInitialized 
deactivate Monitor

== Normal Runtime ==

loop runApp = true

Vision ->> Monitor : HealthReporting()

Decision ->> Monitor : HealthReporting()

FSM ->> Monitor : HealthReporting()

Analytics ->> Monitor : HealthReporting()

Monitor -> Monitor : updateHeartbeatTable()
activate Monitor
Monitor -->> Monitor : heartbeatUpdated 
deactivate Monitor
 
Monitor -> Monitor : checkHeartbeatTimeout()
activate Monitor
Monitor -->> Monitor : timeoutStatus 
deactivate Monitor


end

== Failure Detection ==

opt Decision heartbeat timeout

Monitor -> Monitor : markProcessFailed()
activate Monitor
Monitor -->> Monitor : markedProcessID
deactivate Monitor

Monitor -> Launcher : restartProcess(markedProcessID)

activate Launcher

Launcher -> Launcher : terminateProcess()
activate Launcher
Launcher -->> Launcher : processTerminated
deactivate Launcher

Launcher ->> Decision : terminate()
deactivate Decision

Launcher -> Launcher : fork()+exec(Decision)
activate Launcher
Launcher -->> Launcher : decisionPid
deactivate Launcher 

Launcher -> Decision : start()

activate Decision
Decision -->> Launcher : Ready(PID)

Launcher -> Launcher : updateProcessTable()
activate Launcher
Launcher -->> Launcher : processTableUpdated
deactivate Launcher

Launcher ->> Monitor : restartCompleted()

deactivate Launcher

end

== Normal Shutdown ==

App -> Launcher : terminateAll()

activate Launcher

Launcher ->> Analytics : terminate()
deactivate Analytics

Launcher ->> Vision : terminate()
deactivate Vision

Launcher ->> Decision : terminate()
deactivate Decision

Launcher ->> FSM : terminate()
deactivate FSM

Launcher -->> App : terminateStatus

deactivate Launcher
deactivate App
deactivate Monitor
